texts.zh: 早在他们踏入星系舞台之前，他们的文明就受到了虚境行者集会的支持和塑造成型。
texts.en: Long before their first steps onto the galactic stage, this civilization has been supported and shaped by a Shroudwalker coven.

sections.zh:
我们的祖先流传下来关于导师的神话：他们无所不知，并且塑造了我们文明的早期阶段。通过托梦，他们从遥远的地方与我们交流，将他们关于虚境的知识和智慧传授于我们。

如今我们的导师再次降临，通过在我们的梦境中播撒下光怪陆离的画面，他教会了我们星际航行的秘诀。在短短的几年后，我们便能够建造舰船遨游太空。

不过我们前方的路还有多长？我们的导师指明了“虚境隧道”这条路，那是一个坐落于他们母星系边陲的天然虫洞。创建我们自己的隧道便可以让我们通过这条路拜访导师。在我们踏入星际舞台之际，愿我们的导师继续赐予我们更多的智慧。
sections.en:
The myths of our forebears speak of the Teachers - beings of great knowledge and power who helped to shape our earliest civilization. Through dreams, they approached us from afar, sharing their wisdom of the Shroud and its teachings.

Now our Teachers have reached out once again. Seeding our dreams with eldritch visions, they have provided us with the key to interstellar travel. In just a few years, we have built vessels capable of traversing the void.

But how much farther is it possible to go? Our Teachers refer to a 'Shroud Tunnel' - a natural wormhole that sits at the edge of their home system. Spawning our own Tunnel should give us a direct path to the Teachers themselves. May they continue to grant us wisdom as we take our first steps onto the galactic stage.

sections.zh:
我们教会的创始人如此描述导师：他们无所不知无所不能，他们降下了最初的福音。通过托梦，他们从遥远的地方与我们交流，将他们关于虚境的知识和智慧传授于我们。

如今我们的导师再次降临，通过在我们的梦境中播撒下光怪陆离的画面，他教会了我们星际航行的秘诀。在短短的几年后，我们便能够建造舰船遨游太空。

但这并不是我们雄心壮志的尽头。我们的导师指明了“虚境隧道”这条路，那是一个坐落于他们母星系边陲的天然虫洞。如果我们创建好了这条神圣的通路，我们便能直接与导师会面。在我们踏入星际舞台之际，愿我们的导师继续赐予我们更多的智慧。
sections.en:
The founders of our church wrote of the Teachers - beings of great knowledge and power who helped to shape our earliest gospels. Through dreams, they approached us from afar, sharing their wisdom of the holy Shroud.

Now our Teachers have reached out once again. Seeding our dreams with eldritch visions, they have provided us with the key to interstellar travel. In just a few years, we have built vessels capable of seeding our holy truth throughout the stars.

But that must not mark the limit of our ambition. Our Teachers refer to a 'Shroud Tunnel' - a natural wormhole that sits at the edge of their home system. If we but spawn this holy conduit, we would possess a direct path to the Teachers themselves. May they continue to grant us wisdom as we take our first steps onto the galactic stage.

sections.zh:
我们的祖先流传下来关于导师的神话：他们无所不知，早在我们记忆产生之前就开始指引我们。通过托梦，他们跨越虚空与我们流浪中的先祖交流，将他们关于虚境的知识和智慧传授于我们。

如今我们的导师再次降临，通过在我们的梦境中播撒下光怪陆离的画面，告诉我们连接两颗恒星间的不只有缓慢漂流这一条路，还有一条穿越虚境本身、转瞬之间跨越浩瀚距离的途径。

不过我们前方的路还有多长？我们的导师指明了“虚境隧道”这条路，那是一个坐落于他们母星系边陲的天然虫洞。我们若能创建自己的隧道，便可以通过这条路拜访导师。愿我们立足于群星之间时，导师能继续赐予我们智慧。
sections.en:
The myths of our forebears speak of the Teachers - beings of great knowledge and power who have guided our people since before memory. Through dreams, they reached across the void to our wandering ancestors, sharing their wisdom of the Shroud and its teachings.

Now our Teachers have reached out once again. Seeding our dreams with eldritch visions, they have revealed a path beyond the slow drift between stars - a way to traverse the Shroud itself, crossing vast distances in moments.

But how much farther is it possible to go? Our Teachers refer to a 'Shroud Tunnel' - a natural wormhole that sits at the edge of their home system. Spawning our own Tunnel should give us a direct path to the Teachers themselves. May they continue to grant us wisdom as we take our place among the stars.

texts.zh:
学生们，我们在梦中曾指引你们。通过这些梦境我们塑造了你们的世界。如今你们已茁壮成长，可以将我们的信条传播于星际，你们真正的试炼正刚刚开始。你们的勤勉将光耀虚境，你们的辛劳成果亦是对你们教导的兑现。为了点燃事业之火，我们传授给你们虚境信标的知识，这是一个强大的设备。在你们的一座恒星基地上建造以后，这座信标会打开一个虚境隧道。请谨慎选择地点，因为虚境隧道只会生成一次。

如果有所索求，有所不测就呼唤我们吧。在梦境中我们会一直看着你们。在漫游的旅途中，我们等待着你们的到来。
texts.en:
Students, in dreams we have guided you. Through visions, we have shaped your world. Now that you stand ready to export our doctrine to the stars, your true apprenticeship is at hand. Through your work shall the Shroud be honored. The profits of your labor shall fulfill the promise of our teachings. To stoke the fires of industry, we grant you knowledge of the Shroud Beacon, a device of great power. Once built on one of your starbases, the Beacon will spawn a Shroud Tunnel. Choose its location carefully, as you will not be able to spawn another.

In times of need and uncertainty, call on us. In dreams, we will be watching. In waking life, we await your arrival.

texts.zh:
我们的学生啊，我们已经教导了你们一代又一代，将虚境和它的奥秘的知识播撒入你们的梦境之中。现在你们已经能够触及星辰，你们真正的学徒生涯才刚刚开始。前路不会一马平川。为了照亮你们前行的道路，我们传授给你们虚境信标的知识，这是一个强大的设备。在你们的一座恒星基地上建造以后，这座信标会打开一个虚境隧道。请谨慎选择地点，因为虚境隧道只会生成一次。

如果有所索求，有所不测就呼唤我们吧。在梦境中我们会一直看着你们。在漫游的旅途中，我们等待着你们的到来。
texts.en:
Our students, for generations we have taught you, seeding our knowledge of the Shroud and its mysteries within your dreams. Now that you have reached the stars, your true apprenticeship is at hand. The path forward will not be an easy one. To light the way, we grant you knowledge of the Shroud Beacon, a device of great power. Once built on one of your starbases, the Beacon will spawn a Shroud Tunnel. Choose its location carefully, as you will not be able to spawn another.

In times of need and uncertainty, call on us. In dreams, we will be watching. In waking life, we await your arrival.

label.zh: 我们心怀感激地接受你们的馈赠。
label.en: We receive your gift with gratitude.

tooltips.zh: 允许在己方某个恒星基地建造一个虚境信标。一旦完工，一个虚境隧道会在恒星系中生成，并提供一个通往[shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的双向隧道。我们只能生成一个虚境隧道；因此请谨慎选择恒星系的位置。
tooltips.en: Permits building a Shroud Beacon on one of our Starbases. Once built, it will spawn a Shroud Tunnel, providing passage to and from the [shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName] system. Only one Tunnel can be spawned - choose its location carefully.

tooltips.zh: 允许在己方某个恒星基地建造一个虚境信标。一旦完工，一个虚境隧道会在恒星系中生成，并提供一个通往[shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的双向隧道。我们只能生成一个虚境隧道；因此请谨慎选择恒星系的位置。
tooltips.en: Permits building a Shroud Beacon on one of our Starbases. Once built, it will spawn a Shroud Tunnel, providing passage to and from the [shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName] system. Only one Tunnel can be spawned - choose its location carefully.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附近星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the nearby system's name appears here.

texts.zh: 学徒们，我们终于能和你们好好打招呼了。通过早就铺设好的隧道，你们的到来已经被虚境所感知。你们的回声仍在颤抖、涟漪般回荡过潜意识的水面。虚境神秘中的居者一定会祝福我们的会面。在这里你们是最受欢迎的存在。
texts.en: Apprentices, at last we can greet you properly. Through the Tunnel long prepared, your passage has been felt by the Shroud itself. The echoes yet shiver, rippling through the waters of the unconscious mind. Those who dwell within the mysteries of the Shroud have surely blessed our meeting. You are most welcome here.

texts.zh: 学徒们，我们终于能和你们好好打招呼了。迹象和预兆都预示了这一刻，虚境本身也会见证你们的到来。我们已经期待了很久，只为与你们在感知之境相会。在这里你们是欢迎之至的存在。
texts.en: Apprentices, at last we can greet you properly. Signs and portents foretold this moment, and the Shroud itself has witnessed your passage. Long have we waited to meet with you in the realm of the senses. You are most welcome here.

texts.zh: 在黑暗中漫无止境地摸索之后，虚境的面纱终于被揭开。我们的导师赐予了我们无上的珍宝。这个信标以及其诞生的隧道，注定会照亮我们跨越星际的航道。从这个星系开始的旅途将会更快……也远远地更为神秘。
texts.en: After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Our Teachers have bestowed a great gift upon us. This Beacon, and the Tunnel it spawns, will surely light our way across the stars. Journeys from this system will now be faster... and infinitely more mysterious.

texts.zh:
在黑暗中漫无止境地摸索之后，虚境的面纱终于被揭开。我们的导师赐予了我们无上的珍宝。这个信标以及其召唤出的隧道，注定会照亮我们跨越星际的航道。

还剩下一步：我们导师所居住的那一侧边界至今对我们封闭。地图中实际上的航道对虚境来说可能无关紧要，但是在这边的星球还是非常麻烦。至少现在，我们通过隧道的路径还是被封锁着。
texts.en:
After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Our Teachers have bestowed a great gift upon us. This Beacon, and the Tunnel it spawns, will surely light our way across the stars.

Only one step remains: the border beyond which our Teachers reside is closed to us. Lines on a map may be immaterial to the Shroud, but in this world they remain troublesome. For now, our passage through the Tunnel remains blocked.

label.zh: 愿虚境欢迎我们的到来。
label.en: May the Shroud welcome our passage.

texts.zh: 学徒们，你正在走上一条危险的道路。你以为养育了你们数个世纪的我们会没有注意到吗？我们教导你虚境，是为了启蒙，为了提升。但是这个？力量、暴虐、以及你们亲手酿造的危机。牢记我的教诲！这个宇宙不过是一场幻梦的绰影。为时未晚，赶在你被它毁掉之前，马上放弃这误入歧途的野心。
texts.en: Apprentices, you walk a dangerous path. Did you think we would not notice, we who have nurtured you for centuries? In teaching you of the Shroud, we hoped to enlighten, to elevate. But this? Power and violence, and a crisis of your own making. Remember your teachings! This universe is nothing but the shadow of a dream. There is still time. Give up this misguided ambition before you are destroyed by it.

label.zh: 我们的命运十分清晰。不要挡我们的道。
label.en: Our destiny is clear. Do not stand in our way.

summary.text:
# 虚境导师 / Teachers of the Shroud

- 分类 Category：起源 Origins · DLC：Overlord（虚境行者飞地）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/origin_events_3.txt:1209-1540`、`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`、`events/overlord_enclaves_events.txt`

> 本导读是审阅者的说明文字，不是游戏原文。 This guide is reviewer commentary, not game text.

## 如何开始 How it starts

开局隐藏事件 origin.5600 让帝国认识虚境行者、虚境化若干行星并开始研究灵能理论；开局时出现 5605“真正的学徒”。
Hidden origin.5600 introduces the Shroudwalker enclave, shroud-forms some planets and starts Psionic Theory; 5605 *True Apprentices* appears at game start.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 5605 → 教程（飞地外交）。 5605 -> the enclave diplomacy tutorial.
- 舰队首次进入飞地星系 → 5620“欢迎学徒”。 First entry into the enclave system -> 5620.
- 建成虚境信标 → 5625“点亮信标”。 Shroud Beacon built -> 5625.
- enclave.4243 为每月检查的飞地警告。 enclave.4243: a monthly enclave warning.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支。 No branches.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

5610 / 5615 区分进入方式（超空间或虚境隧道）。 5610 / 5615 tell how the enclave system was entered.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：origin.5600–5625 与钩子。 Events 5600-5625 and hooks.
- 更正 Corrections：入口标签。 Entry labels.
